c.tagline: Korea's volcanic holiday island — Hallasan's peak, lava-rock coasts, and endless beaches.

taxi.fareNote: Hail on the street or book via Kakao T; all taxis are metered. On Jeju, taxis handle airport runs and short hops, but most visitors rent a car to tour the island's coast and Hallasan trailheads.

hood_desc: Jeju City's historic downtown, built around the Dongmun Traditional Market, the Chilseong-ro shopping arcade and the old Gwandeokjeong pavilion. A walkable, atmospheric base for street food, markets and local life close to the harbor.

The 'new city' district of Yeon-dong, Jeju's hub for hotels, department stores, duty-free shopping and the neon Nuwemaru pedestrian street where the island's dining and nightlife concentrate. Best for travelers who want modern comforts and things open late.

A newer residential quarter near the Halla Arboretum and several of Jeju's larger resort hotels — quieter and greener than downtown but still minutes from the airport and Sinjeju. Suits families and travelers with a rental car.

Jeju City's northern seafront, running from Tapdong Plaza along the coast to the lava-formed Yongduam (Dragon Head Rock) and the Yongyeon gorge. Great for sunset walks, cafes and easy sightseeing by the water.
A relaxed beach neighborhood west of the center, known for Iho Tewoo Beach with its horse-shaped lighthouses and shallow swimming water. A calm, local-feeling spot for a seaside stay.

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink, though most locals prefer bottled or filtered.

transit.pay: Tap a T-money or Cashbee card on boarding and again on transfer; a single ride is about ₩1,150-1,200 with free transfers within 40 minutes. Cash is accepted but exact change is expected. There is no rail or metro anywhere on Jeju.
transit.hours: City and intercity buses run roughly 6:00 AM to around 10:00 PM (a few airport-linked routes later); after that, taxis and Kakao T fill the gap. Many visitors rent a car to reach the coast and Hallasan trailheads.

ferry: Jeju Port (car ferries to Wando, Mokpo and mainland Korea)

transit.m: Airport Limousine Bus (600) to Jeju City and Seogwipo hotels
Taxi to Jeju City center, 10-15 min

tip.r: Not customary in Korea; tipping is not expected.
